notes.en:
• The sidebar avatar now opens account information, balance, models, recharge, usage and Settings. Browser sign-in confirms success only after secure storage and model synchronization, then returns to the website dashboard.
• Windows corners use smooth antialiased transparency. Project rows use the normal arrow cursor. The website offers a dedicated download page.
• Existing API providers, local conversations and permission settings remain. The Electron/network security repairs from 1.1.1 are included; unresolved dependency advisories are not claimed fixed.
• Download opens the public release page; installation remains manual.
notes.zh-CN:
• 左下角头像可打开账号资料、余额、模型、充值、用量和设置。浏览器授权完成安全存储及模型同步后才提示登录成功，随后返回网站控制台。
• Windows 窗口圆角改为平滑抗锯齿透明边缘；项目行悬停使用普通箭头；网站新增客户端下载页。
• 保留原有 API 服务、本地会话和权限设置，继续包含 1.1.1 的 Electron 与网络安全修复；未宣称其他依赖安全公告已全部解决。
• 下载按钮打开公开发布页，安装仍由你手动完成。
